'''Vizam''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Weapons master/Legends|weapons master]] who worked for<ref name="Who's Who" /> and guarded<ref name="Card">{{Topps|set=1983 Topps Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Series 1|cardname=The Deadly Cannon|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/72969/cid/5256900/1983-Topps-Return-Of-The-Jedi-50-The-Deadly-Cannon}}</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He<ref name="Who's Who" /> kept the crime lord's vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] well-armed. Aboard Jabba's<ref name="CCG" /> [[Luxury-class sail barge|''Luxury''-class sail barge]],<ref name="LONH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'',<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Vizam stashed many hidden weapon caches.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vizam can be seen in standing behind [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|Jabba's dais]] within [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] during [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and later aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna's'']] top-deck.
[[File:Vizam2.jpg|thumb|left|Vizam during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|the battle]].]]
In 1999, Hasbro produced an action figure based on Vizam (simply named "Nikto"). He was packaged in the Cinema Scene set "Jabba's Skiff Guards". The same figure was later repacked in the "Skirmish At Carkoon" set, released in 2004. In 2014, Hasbro released a brand-new, super articulated Vizam as part of The Black Series 3.75" line.
